features.name: FastAPI app (:9011)
features.detail: Single app, title='QI Brain API', version='002'. All Brain logic lives here; MCP server is a thin client. CORS allow_origins=['*'] (local-only). Mounts poller + distiller at module import.

features.name: Health / version / info probes
features.detail: GET /health -> {status, service, port:9011, version}. /version reports build 2026-04-20. /info lists capabilities + endpoint count + /docs URL — used by qi_validator + uptime monitors.

features.name: Status dashboard endpoint
features.detail: GET /api/status aggregates active_projects, active_decisions (superseded_by IS NULL), features_logged, pending_reviews, sessions_logged, chroma_counts, providers_active.

features.name: QI_BrainAPI NSSM service
features.detail: Service QI_BrainAPI, binary C:\1-AI\APPS\PYTHON\python.exe, params C:\QIH\engine\brain\api.py, AppDirectory C:\QIH, log C:\QIH\engine\brain\LOGS\qi_brain_api.log. Port 9011 (9010 squatted by Logitech G HUB, moved 2026-05-14).

features.name: stdio JSON-RPC bridge
features.detail: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdin/stdout. Handles initialize / tools/list / tools/call. ~150 LOC of forwarders — every tool call POST/GETs to BRAIN_API=http://localhost:9011. run_in_executor(sys.stdin.readline) avoids the Windows ProactorEventLoop pipe crash.

features.name: TOOLS definitions
features.detail: 12 inputSchema definitions returned on tools/list: qi_get_context, qi_log_decision, qi_log_feature, qi_get_pending_features, qi_decide_on_feature, qi_update_project_state, qi_search_memory, qi_log_session, qi_get_ecosystem_snapshot, qi_supersede_decision, qi_explain, qi_override_evaluation.

features.name: Tool dispatcher
features.detail: match/case router mapping each tool name to its FastAPI path. ConnectError -> -32000 'QI Brain API unreachable at :9011'. Unknown tool -> {ok:false}.

features.name: qi.get_context (ranked, budgeted)
features.detail: Pulls latest project_state, then decisions WHERE superseded_by IS NULL AND (project_id=? OR scope IN ecosystem/global) AND recorded_at>=cutoff, ordered same-project-first. Accumulates _est_tokens until token_budget (default 2000, context_days 14).

features.name: qi.log_decision
features.detail: INSERT INTO decisions (tags as JSON), then await _memory().add_decision() to embed title+rationale into qi_decisions. Chroma failure is caught — DB write is authoritative. Returns decision_id.

features.name: qi.log_feature + propagate
features.detail: INSERT INTO features, embed into qi_features. If propagate_now, calls feature_engine.propagate_feature(feature_id) to fan out evaluations across all other active projects.

features.name: qi.log_session
features.detail: INSERT INTO session_log (files_changed as JSON array), embed title+summary into qi_sessions. Records decisions_made, features_logged, model_used, started_at.

features.name: qi.update_project_state
features.detail: Append-only INSERT into project_state (phase, status, summary, blockers, next_steps). Latest row per project = current state.

features.name: qi.search_memory
features.detail: Maps collection name (decisions|features|sessions|docs) -> Chroma collection, optional where={project_id}, delegates to MemoryStore.search(). Returns id/document/metadata/distance.

features.name: qi.supersede_decision (I-08)
features.detail: Verifies both decision_ids exist, then UPDATE decisions SET superseded_by/superseded_at/superseded_reason. Superseded rows are excluded from get_context but stay queryable.

features.name: qi.explain (I-10)
features.detail: subject_type decision|feature|session|project -> assembles a markdown writeup + citations. Decisions flag SUPERSEDED; features list every target's recommendation + relevance score.

features.name: qi.get_pending_features
features.detail: JOIN feature_evaluations + features WHERE decided=0, ordered by relevance_score DESC. Optional target_project filter.

features.name: qi.decide_on_feature
features.detail: UPDATE feature_evaluations SET decided=1, decided_at, decided_action (adopt|adapt|skip|discuss).

features.name: qi.override_evaluation (I-14)
features.detail: INSERT INTO evaluation_overrides (Law 6 owner override). Endpoint live; 0 rows used so far.

features.name: open_brain_db (WAL helper)
features.detail: Single connection factory every module uses. Applies PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, synchronous=NORMAL, busy_timeout=5000, foreign_keys=ON per connection; row_factory=sqlite3.Row. DB_PATH = C:\QIH\data\qi_brain.db (override via QI_BRAIN_DB env).

features.name: Schema + init_db
features.detail: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS throughout + seed agents. init_db() splits on ';' and executes per-statement (executescript ignores PRAGMAs). 25 tables live; idempotent.

features.name: ChromaDB MemoryStore (4 collections)
features.detail: PersistentClient at qi_memory/, get_or_create_collection with hnsw:space=cosine. Collections qi_decisions/qi_features/qi_sessions/qi_docs. add_*() upsert ids like decision_{id}; search() embeds query then col.query(n_results).

features.name: Cross-process reload
features.detail: Drops the cached MemoryStore so the next call re-reads Chroma from disk — fixes the stale in-memory HNSW segment after an out-of-process doc_harvester write.

features.name: ProviderFactory
features.detail: Loads providers from llm_providers WHERE active=1. _TYPE_MAP routes provider_type -> class (ollama, nomic_embed). API keys resolved from api_key_env env var name, never stored. get_by_role('embed'|'eval'|'general'|'heavy').

features.name: NomicEmbedProvider
features.detail: 768-dim vectors via Ollama /api/embeddings (model nomic-embed-text). generate() is disabled — embed-only. The sole embedder for all 4 Chroma collections.

features.name: OllamaProvider
features.detail: Local /api/generate (stream=False). _strip_think() removes <think>...</think> from reasoning models. Used by the feature engine for relevance evaluation (eval_model qwen3:8b).

features.name: BrainProvider ABC
features.detail: Abstract base + ProviderResponse dataclass. 5 active providers seeded in DB: ollama_qwen3_8b (eval), qwen3_4b + deepseek-r1:8b (general), gemma4:31b (heavy), nomic_embed_text (embed).

features.name: Background poller
features.detail: Daemon thread started at API import. Each cycle reads <project>/data/state.json + git log --since, processes inbox/*.json older than poll_min_file_age_s. Config in brain_config (poll_interval_s=300, poll_enabled=1). 18,718 cycles in poll_log.

features.name: Inbox ingest
features.detail: File-based message drop at C:\QIH\engine\brain\inbox\. Poller files each JSON message; brain_inbox_log records ingest history.

features.name: Distiller
features.detail: LLM summarization of raw notes into structured records (VALID_REASONS gate). Endpoint + /api/distill/history live; light real use.

features.name: Feature propagation engine
features.detail: For each active project != source, builds an eval prompt (with last-5-eval history per target), calls eval_model, parses strict JSON {relevance_score, recommendation, reasoning, confidence}, one retry on bad JSON, INSERTs feature_evaluations + marks feature propagated.

features.name: Agent registry + growth
features.detail: 14 agents (claude, 7 hive sub-agents, maia/naya/nexus, system). agent_growth_log captures post-task learnings; profile endpoint aggregates growth + patterns.

features.name: Heartbeats + War Room
features.detail: agent_heartbeats (1,643 rows) drives the War Room presence board; warroom_messages (11) is the persisted agent chat.

features.name: Dispatch pipeline
features.detail: dispatches (2,873) carry status + apply_state; dispatch_runs (7) track builder log, inspector verdict, diff/worktree/commit for the autonomous build-review loop.

features.name: Compliance log
features.detail: compliance_log (46,654 rows) records Inspector findings: check_id, status, severity, auto_fixable, fix_action, linked dispatch_id.

features.name: Doc harvester + knowledge graph
features.detail: Discovers + classifies every .md/.docx in the ecosystem into docs (921 rows), derives typed edges into doc_relationships (2,203). Optional embed into qi_docs. Self-ensures tables; prune() drops vanished files. Migration migrations/2026_06_18_doc_index.sql.

features.name: Idempotent bootstrap
features.detail: create_db -> seed_agents -> seed_providers -> seed_config -> seed_projects (from qi_registry) -> init_chroma -> ingest_docs -> ingest_summaries -> seed_decisions -> log_bootstrap. Each tracked in bootstrap_log (9 steps done); safe to re-run, --reset re-runs all.

features.name: SQL migrations
features.detail: Dated idempotent migrations: 2026_05_13_agent_heartbeats, 2026_05_13_auto_apply, 2026_06_18_doc_index, 2026_06_18_warroom_chat. Applied via run_migration.py.

features.name: Backup task
features.detail: Scheduled SQLite backup of qi_brain.db; brain_config backup_enabled=true, backup_retain=30.

features.name: Smoke test
features.detail: Pytest smoke check of the Brain API surface; part of the ecosystem SMOKE_TARGETS suite.
